topic: Buying a Cashier's Check for an Apartment Deposit

script.title: THE CASHIER'S CHECK
script.scene_zh: 銀行櫃台 · 開本票付押金
script.story_hook: A new apartment needs one very official check.
script.intro_zh: 新租的公寓，需要一張很正式的本票。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's bank scene. Listen for cashier's check phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的銀行場景。留意開本票的實用說法。
script.outro: And that's a deposit check done right. Listen again and repeat the polite lines.
script.outro_zh: 一張押金本票就這樣開好了。再聽一次，跟著複習有禮貌的句型。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: You sign only when you hand it over
script.char_a_description: a college-age young man with short black hair under a mustard beanie, a grey hoodie, a worn backpack on one shoulder, white sneakers, and a lanky build
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged Sikh woman with long black hair in a thick braid, gold hoop earrings, a maroon blazer over a cream kameez, a thin gold bracelet, and a sturdy build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need to buy a cashier's check, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid tə baɪ ə kəˈʃɪrz tʃɛk pliz/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想開一張銀行本票，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. Is it for a big purchase?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɚ θɪŋ ɪz ɪt fɚ ə bɪɡ ˈpɝtʃəs/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。是要買什麼大件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is, um, my apartment deposit, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ʌm maɪ əˈpɑɹtmənt dɪˈpɑzɪt ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 其實是，嗯，我要付新公寓的押金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, good luck with the move! Who's it for?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd lʌk wɪð ðə muv huz ɪt fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，搬家順利！本票要開給誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The landlord. He only takes cashier's checks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɑɹdlənd hi ˈoʊnli ˈteɪks kəˈʃɪrz tʃɛks/
dialogue.zh: 房東。他只收這種本票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Do you know how those work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt du ju noʊ haʊ ðoz wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 了解。你知道這種本票怎麼運作嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, no. Isn't it just a regular check?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli noʊ ˈɪzənt ɪt dʒʌst ə ˈɛɡjəlɚ tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，不知道。它跟一般支票不一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close, but the bank pays it, not you.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz bʌt ðə bæŋk peɪz ɪt nɑt ju/
dialogue.zh: 很接近，但付錢的是銀行，不是你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, so the money leaves the bank's account?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt soʊ ðə ˈmʌni livz ðə bæŋks əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 等等，所以錢是從銀行的帳戶出去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It comes out of your balance today, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kʌmz aʊt əv jɔɹ ˈbæləns təˈdeɪ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過今天就會從你的餘額裡扣掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the landlord knows it can't bounce?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈlɑɹdlənd noʊz ɪt kænt baʊns/
dialogue.zh: 所以房東能確定這張票不會跳票？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right. That's why landlords love them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ðæts waɪ ˈlɑɹdləndz lʌv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 對。這就是房東最愛它的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Makes sense. Mine's paranoid about paperwork.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪks sɛns maɪnz ˈpɛɹəˌnɔɪd əˈbaʊt ˈpɛɹˌpɛɹˌwɝk/
dialogue.zh: 有道理。我的房東對書面文件超講究。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, mine too. Who should it be payable to?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪn tu hu ʃʊd ɪt bi ˈpeɪəbl tu/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我的也是。本票要開給誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, Graystone Property Management, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈɡɹeɪstoʊn ˈpɹɑpɚti məˈnɪdʒmənt aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我想是 Graystone 物業管理公司。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Think, or know? The name prints on the check.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪŋk ɔɹ noʊ ðə ˈneɪm prɪnts ɑn ðə tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 是「想想」還是「確定」？這個名字會印在本票上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! Let me check my lease text, one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ lɛt mi tʃɛk maɪ lis tɛkst wʌn ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 噢！等我一下，我查房東傳的租約訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time... that's a very common trip-up.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔɹ taɪm ðæts ə ˈvɛɹi ˈkɑmən ˈtɹɪp ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來……很多人都在這裡踩雷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is: Graystone Properties, with an s.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ɪt ɪz ˈɡɹeɪstoʊn ˈpɹɑpɚtiz wɪð æn ɛs/
dialogue.zh: 找到了：是 Graystone Properties，結尾有 s。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good catch! The s matters, believe it or not.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kætʃ ðə ɛs ˈmæɾɚz bɪˈliv ɪt ɔɹ nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 好眼力！別說，這個 s 真的很要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, first try and I almost messed that up.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ fɝst tɹaɪ ænd aɪ əˈmoʊst mɛst ðæt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 哇，第一次差點就把這步搞砸了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people skip it, and the check gets rejected.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl skɪp ɪt ænd ðə tʃɛk ɡɛts ɹɪˈdʒɛktɪd/
dialogue.zh: 多數人懶得查，結果本票退回來，只能重開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rejected? Then what happens to my money?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈdʒɛktɪd ðɛn wət ˈhæpənz tə maɪ ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 退回來？那我的錢會怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'd mail it back and wait for weeks, I hear.
dialogue.phonetic: /jud meɪl ɪt bæk ænd weɪt fɚ wikz aɪ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我聽說要寄回去，再等上好幾個星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No thanks. Okay, it's for twelve hundred, due Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ θæŋks oʊˈkeɪ ɪts fɔɹ twɛlft ˈhʌndɪd, du ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那還得了。好，金額一千兩百，星期五要交。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve hundred... that's above our daily cap here.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlft ˈhʌndɪd ðæts əˈbʌv aʊɹ ˈdeɪli kæp hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 一千兩百……這超過我們單日的開票上限了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Huh? What does that mean for Friday, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌɡ wət ˈdʌz ðæt min fɚ ˈfɹaɪdeɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 啊？那這樣星期五怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can write nine hundred max, same-day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən ɹaɪt naɪn ˈhʌndɪd mæks seɪm deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 當天最多能開九百美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I need two checks? Is that allowed?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ nid tu tʃɛks ɪz ðæt əˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 所以我得開兩張？這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Landlords usually say yes, but call to confirm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɑɹdləndz ˈjuʒəwəli seɪ jɛs bʌt kɔl tə kənˈfɝm/
dialogue.zh: 房東一般都接受，不過還是打電話確認一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea. Um, will I pay one fee or two?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə ʌm wɪl aɪ peɪ wʌn fim ɔɹ tu/
dialogue.zh: 好主意。呃，那手續費收一次還是兩次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five dollars each, so ten total for two.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈdɑlərz itʃ soʊ tɛn ˈtoʊɾəl fɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 一張五美元，兩張一共十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. What else do you need from me today?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ wət ɛls du ju nid fɹʌm mi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 合理。還有什麼需要我提供的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your ID, and it can't be expired.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ aɪˈdi ænd ɪt kænt bi ɪkˈspɪɹd/
dialogue.zh: 你的身分證，而且不能過期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Driver's license, right here, still valid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɹaɪvɚz ˈlaɪsəns ɹaɪt hɪɹ stɪl ˈvælɪd/
dialogue.zh: 駕照就在這裡，還在有效期內。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Do you have a checking account with us?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt du ju hæv ə ˈtʃɛkɪŋ əˈkaʊnt wɪð ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。你在我們銀行有支票帳戶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, opened one last month for rent stuff.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs oʊˈpɛnd wʌn læst mʌnθ fɚ ɹɛnt ˈstʌf/
dialogue.zh: 有，上個月為了房租相關的事開了一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There it is. Should the funds come from that one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ ɪt ɪz ʃʊd ðə fʌndz kʌm fɹʌm ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 找到帳戶了。錢要從這一戶扣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. Oh, do I sign the cashier's check too?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs oʊ du aɪ saɪn ðə kəˈʃɪrz tʃɛk tu/
dialogue.zh: 對。噢，那本票上我要簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet! You sign only when you hand it over.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt ju saɪn ˈoʊnli wɛn ju hænd ɪt ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 先別！要等到把票交給人家的當下才簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That I did not know. What about a memo line?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt aɪ dɪd nɑt noʊ wət əˈbaʊt ə ˈmoʊmoʊ laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這個我真不知道。那備註欄要寫什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add your apartment number — it helps us track it.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd jɔɹ əˈpɑɹtmənt ˈnʌmbɚ ɪt hɛlpz əs træk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 在那裡寫上你的門牌號——方便我們追蹤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Unit twelve B. Can you add that now?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ˈjuːnɪt twɛlft bi kən ju æd ðæt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好。12B 室，你現在能加上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, twelve B... done, see it right there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɚ twɛlft bi dʌn si ɪt ɹaɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，12B……好了，看到了嗎？就在上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do. Very official looking. Can I get a receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ˈvɛɹi əˈfɪʃəl ˈlʊkɪŋ kən aɪ ɡɛt ə ɹɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，好正式的感覺。可以給我收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, here's your copy with the check numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs hɪɹz jɔɹ ˈkɑpi wɪð ðə tʃɛk ˈnʌmbɚz/
dialogue.zh: 當然，這是你的存根，兩張票號都在上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I photograph it before I mail anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈfoʊtoʊˌɡræf ɪt bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ meɪl ˈɛniθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 寄出去之前，我該先拍張照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, keep a photo and the receipt together.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɝt kip ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ænd ðə ɹɪˈsit təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，照片和收據放在一起收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, um, what if the move falls through?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌm wət ɪf ðə muv fɑlz θɹu/
dialogue.zh: 好，呃，萬一這房子沒租成呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring both back, we cancel them for a small fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪn boθ bæk wi ˈkænsəl ðɛm fɚ ə smɑl fim/
dialogue.zh: 把兩張都拿回來，我們辦作廢，只收一點手續費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five dollars again? Well, that's survivable.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈdɑlərz əˈɡɛn wɛl ðæts sɚˈvaɪvəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 又是五美元？嗯，那還承受得起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheaper than a lost deposit, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃipɚ ðən ə lɑst dɪˈpɑzɪt tɹʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 這可比押金丟了划算多了，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. Everything's printed, names and all. Thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu ˈɛvɹiθɪŋz ˈpɹɪntɪd neɪmz ænd ɔl θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 也是。名字什麼的都印好了。謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, nine hundred and three hundred, two checks.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ naɪn ˈhʌndɪd ænd θɹi ˈhʌndɪd tu tʃɛks/
dialogue.zh: 好，九百外加三百，一共兩張本票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! You even wrote it out neatly. You're a lifesaver.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ju ˈivən ɹoʊt ɪt aʊt ˈnili jʊɹz ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對！你還寫得整整齊齊。你真是救星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, filling forms is my job. Enjoy the apartment.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈfɪlɪŋ fɔɹmz ɪz maɪ dʒɑb ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ði əˈpɑɹtmənt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，填表就是我的工作。好好享受新公寓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Friday, twelve B, that's the plan now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈfɹaɪdeɪ twɛlft bi ðæts ðə plæn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。星期五、12B，就這麼定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the plan. Come by if anything feels off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə plæn kʌm baɪ ɪf ˈɛnɪθɪŋ filz ɑf/
dialogue.zh: 就這麼定了。有任何不對，來分行找我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Thanks for explaining every little part.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du θæŋks fɚ ɪkˈspleɪnɪŋ ˈɛvɹi ˈlɪɾəl pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 會的。謝謝你把每個小細節都講給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, welcome to the neighborhood, almost!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm ˈwɛlkəm tə ðə ˈneɪbəɹˌhʊd ɔlˈmoʊst/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，歡迎搬來這一區——就快是鄰居了！

script.youtube_title_en: "You Sign Only When You Hand It Over" — Buying a Cashier's Check for Rent
script.youtube_description:
租屋要付押金，房東卻只收銀行本票，第一次開這種票怎麼辦？這一集 60 句沉浸式英語聽力，帶你坐進美國銀行櫃台，從收款人名字一路聽到備註欄與收據。

你會聽到：本票和普通支票差在哪裡；收款人名字怎麼確認才不會讓銀行退票；金額超過單日限額時怎麼拆成兩張；帶身分證、簽名時機、備註欄寫門牌號等實用細節；還有退票、作廢的問句。

整段對話都是 A2 初級單字與十個詞以內的短句，充滿真實語感：um、well、so、ha、oh。聽完你就會用：Who should it be payable to、What does that mean for Friday、Can I get a receipt。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著唸，開票的句子自然長在嘴上。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱並打開小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
Your landlord only accepts a cashier's check, and it's your first time buying one. This 60-line immersive listening practice sits with you at the bank counter, from the payee name to the memo line.

You will hear: how a cashier's check differs from a personal one, how to confirm the exact payee name so it never gets rejected, what happens when the amount is above the daily cap, plus ID, signing timing, receipts, and canceling fees.

Everything stays in A2-level words, ten per line at most, with real texture: um, well, so, ha, oh. By the end you'll own lines like Who should it be payable to and Can I get a receipt.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout — speak out loud and let the bank talk become instinct.

No memorizing needed — listen often and it sticks.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
星期五就要交押金，房東卻只要銀行本票，這種票到底是什麼？名字寫錯一個字母會怎樣？金額超過銀行單日上限，該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進美國銀行櫃台，從認識本票、確認收款人姓名、拆成兩張開票，一路聽到備註欄、收據與作廢規則，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🏦 認識本票：Close, but the bank pays it, not you.
🧾 確認名字：Think, or know? The name prints on the check.
💵 限額對策：So I need two checks? Is that allowed?
✍️ 簽名時機：Not yet! You sign only when you hand it over.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這張本票走一趟櫃台，下次你真的要開票時，句子自己就會冒出來。

祝你新家的鑰匙早日到手。
